basic_info.description: At the crest of Sargent Street in desirable Ingleside Heights, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home offers an incredible opportunity for the right buyer. Solid bones, a corner location, garage parking, wood-burning fireplace, rear yard with deck, city views, and possible development potential, this residence is ready to be reimagined and restored to its full glory.  Bring your vision.  Ideally located near Stonestown, Westlake Shopping Center, City College of San Francisco, UCSF, Stern Grove, the SF Zoo, Ocean Beach, and the Great Highway, this property combines convenience, community, and endless potential in one of San Francisco's most accessible neighborhoods.  With vision and care, 501 Sargent Street can become a standout home in a sought-after San Francisco neighborhood.
